modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Okay, so here is another Kling 4.0 video, I just love how good it looks and the movement of the creature is almost perfect 😍 You can find the prompt below as always btw 😉 https://t.co/hUYjjTjvKm

originalPrompt: A living mechanical predator with a glowing orange central eye moves through dense alien jungle vegetation, using long metallic limbs wrapped in pulsing flesh to pull itself between trees, organic tendrils grabbing branches while hydraulic joints extend and retract, the creature suddenly notices the camera and rapidly charges forward, handheld tracking camera retreats through foliage, branches break naturally, mud splashes, vines react realistically, intense acceleration, realistic weight and momentum, dark cinematic lighting, high-end creature VFX.
